name: Rising Spirit
summary: Rising Spirit is a ritual blessing offered by the captured Razormane geomancer Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo. In exchange for blood shards wrested from his Bristleback rivals, Mangletooth channels the ancient power of Agamaggan to invigorate a champion's willpower and spiritual fortitude.

sections.title: Willpower of the Razormane
sections.body: Held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, the Razormane elder Mangletooth possesses deep knowledge of quillboar geomancy and ancestral magic. While other tribes may boast of raw combat ferocity, Mangletooth takes immense pride in his people's spiritual devotion to their creator, the Great Boar Agamaggan. He teaches that an unbroken spirit is what sustains a warrior when strength alone falters in battle, driving champions onward when defeat seems certain.

sections.title: The Power of Blood Shards
sections.body: To invoke this spiritual elevation, Mangletooth demands blood shards—crystallized fragments steeped in the ancient blood of Agamaggan that seeped into the red earth ten thousand years ago. By bringing him shards harvested from across the Barrens, particularly from his Bristleback enemies, you provide the raw spiritual conduit needed for him to weave a blessing of rising spirit that bolsters your will.

faq.answer: Mangletooth is an elder Razormane quillboar kept in a wooden cage in Camp Taurajo. Despite being a captive of the Horde, he is willing to share sacred geomantic rituals in exchange for blood shards, using travelers to strike blows against the rival Bristleback tribe.

Blood shards are red mineral crystals formed from the spilled blood of the Ancient Demigod Agamaggan, who died in the Barrens during the War of the Ancients. They hold potent residual magic that quillboar shamans and geomancers harness for boons and rituals.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth help Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: Mangletooth harbors a bitter hatred for the rival Bristleback quillboar. By exchanging blessings for blood shards, he encourages powerful adventurers to slaughter Bristlebacks across the Barrens, advancing his tribe's feud even while locked in a cage.

faq.q: What does the Rising Spirit blessing do?
faq.answer: Rising Spirit is a potent ancestral blessing bestowed by Mangletooth that enhances a warrior's spirit and internal resolve, drawing on Agamaggan's enduring life force to keep hope alive through grueling encounters.

Agamaggan is the colossal Boar Ancient who fought the Burning Legion ten thousand years ago during the War of the Ancients. The quillboar revere him as their creator, believing that the thorny brambles and red blood shards of the Barrens sprouted directly from his fallen body.

faq.q: Is this ritual a one-time trade?
faq.answer: No. As long as you bring Mangletooth four blood shards, the captive elder is willing to perform the ritual repeatedly to renew the blessing before you venture back out into the wastes.

angles.text: Priests will recognize the quillboar's communion with Agamaggan as a raw, primal expression of faith and spirit that rivals the organized devotions of eastern churches.
Shaman understand how deeply ancient bloodlines and earth minerals can bind the spirits of the land to a mortal warrior.
For Horde wanderers in the Barrens, exploiting Mangletooth's deep tribal hatred of the Bristlebacks turns a captive nuisance into a valuable tactical advantage.
